description: Bornes wifi - Réseau Val de Loire Wifi Public - CC Grand Chambord is a dataset listed in data-grandchambord open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Val de Loire Numérique. Bornes wifi sur le territoire de la Communauté de communes Grand Chambord. Données issues du SMO Val de Loire Numérique: Un Wifi territorial est une solution d’accès à internet gratuite, portée par un acteur public. Coverage: Grand Chambord (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Économie/Europe. Its keywords are bornes, wifi, reseau public, internet. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-grandchambord-fr-portal.
